name: autodevops-bridge
description: Reusable GitHub Runner-based development, deployment, diagnostics, status, and rollback workflows for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Safely deploy and maintain self-hosted projects
interface.longDescription: Connect GitHub repositories to self-hosted runners, inspect sanitized production status, trigger tested deployments, collect diagnostics, and roll back releases without exposing SSH keys or unrestricted shell access to ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Check the current health and deployment state of my project.
Diagnose the latest failed deployment and explain the likely cause.
Deploy the latest tested main branch release.
Prepare a safe rollback to the previous production release.
